events.title: THE LATE READING ROOM
events.description: The oak reading hall settles into its evening rhythm. A student edits a short film in the lower media suite while two others compare notes at a green-shaded lamp. Someone finds a reference that had eluded the group all week and quietly sends the page number around.

events.title: THE EVENING TRAINING GROUP
events.description: The training group gathers beneath the high timber roof. They move through warm-ups, careful sets and recovery work, trading observations about technique. Afterward they linger by the pool windows, making plans to walk back to the dormitory together.

events.title: SUPPER IN THE COMMON KITCHEN
events.description: The kitchen fills gradually. Someone has put rice on, another is chopping vegetables, and a third is trying to rescue a pan from yesterday. The conversation moves between coursework, a new record, and who has borrowed the good screwdriver. Nobody eats alone unless he wants to.

events.title: THE QUAD BETWEEN LECTURES
events.description: A group of students leaves the engineering lecture hall together. One carries a model under his arm; another is still explaining why the bridge supports need to be moved. They settle beneath the plane trees and the discussion becomes less formal, turning into plans for the afternoon.
